# ForexAnalyzer Pro

> ForexAnalyzer Pro is an MT5 trading analytics dashboard for traders who want live account monitoring, trade history analysis, a daily profit calendar, journal tools, alerts, copy-trading controls, and secure Google/Supabase account isolation.

## Primary URLs

- [Website](https://www.forexanalyzerpro.com/)
- [Login](https://www.forexanalyzerpro.com/login)
- [Sitemap](https://www.forexanalyzerpro.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Full AI summary](https://www.forexanalyzerpro.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Free trial EA](https://www.mql5.com/en/market/product/111375)
- [Paid EA](https://www.mql5.com/en/market/product/182969)
- [Support](https://www.forexanalyzerpro.com/support)

## What To Know

- The product is built for MetaTrader 5 users.
- Most dashboard routes require authentication and contain private user trading data.
- Public share links can expose user-approved read-only analytics, but they should not be indexed by default.
- The backend API is hosted separately at https://api.forexanalyzerpro.com.
